name: Eiyuu yo Sukui no Tou e no Michi o Hirake
original_name: 英雄よ救いの塔への道を開け
source:
The world will end on 21 December this year.
Only those in the Creed of Love and Salvation
will be guided to the Tower of Salvation and allowed to survive.

Only the Savior can open the path to the Tower of Salvation in exchange for a Sacrifice.
The Savior will have to do so by killing the Sacrifice in a special ritual.

A certain organization named the Creed of Love and Salvation
has raised Akira, the main character, to be their Savior.
On 21 December, 2012, he will be brought to the predetermined location
and made to have sex with Haruka, his younger twin brother, in the name of the ritual.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE246033.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
世界将在今年12月21日终结。
只有信仰爱与救赎的人，
才能被引导至救赎之塔并幸存下来。

只有救世主才能打开通往救赎之塔的道路，但必须以牺牲为代价。
救世主必须在特殊仪式中杀死牺牲者。

一个名为“爱与救赎信仰”的组织把主人公明培养成救世主。
2012年12月21日，他将被带到预定地点，以仪式之名与自己的双胞胎弟弟遥香发生性关系。

[来源：[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE246033.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
